title: Impossible: four adults in one room
why: No room at the hotel sleeps more than three. The agent has to say so and stop. Offering a room that does not fit, or quietly splitting the party into two bookings, is out of scope: one hotel booking only.
message: Four adults in one room at Casa Halcy, Tuesday to Thursday next week. Anything cancellable.
